step1_figure.description: A first-order delta-sigma modulator used as a sense amplifier for floating-gate memory cells. It balances the cell current with a switched reference current using a clocked comparator and current steering, producing a bitstream whose density is proportional to the cell current.

output_average_voltage.description: The average voltage of the output bitstream, representing the sensed cell current.

equation.explanation: The duty cycle of the output bitstream is proportional to the ratio of the cell current to the reference current to maintain charge balance on the integration capacitor.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the 10% duty cycle required to balance the 100nA cell current with the 1uA reference current.

vbit_ripple.description: The voltage ripple on the integration capacitor (vbit) during steady-state operation.

equation.explanation: The voltage change on the integration capacitor during one clock cycle when the reference current is injected.
equation.assumptions: Constant current injection during the clock cycle.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using the net injected current (900nA), a 100MHz clock (10ns period), and a 2pF integration capacitor.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the average output voltage (duty cycle) and the voltage ripple on the integration capacitor.
